reference_sql:
WITH lead_steps AS (  -- one row per lead created in the period, with its opportunity if any
  SELECT l.email, l.source, o.opportunity_id, o.is_won
  FROM leads l
  LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
  WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT source,
       COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS contacts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN email END) AS with_opportunity,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_won THEN email END) AS won
FROM lead_steps
GROUP BY source
alternatives:
SELECT l.source,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.email) AS contacts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN l.email END) AS with_opportunity,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.email) FILTER (WHERE o.is_won) AS won
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
WHERE date_part('year', l.created_at) = 2024
GROUP BY l.source

SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS contacts, SUM(has_opportunity) AS with_opportunity, SUM(has_won) AS won
FROM (  -- one row per source and email with a 2024 lead, 1 or 0 for each later step
  SELECT l.source, l.email,
         MAX(CASE WHEN o.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_opportunity,
         MAX(CASE WHEN o.is_won THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_won
  FROM leads l
  LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id
  WHERE l.created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND l.created_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY l.source, l.email
) AS contacts
GROUP BY source

other_way.tradeoff: One row per source and email with 0 or 1 flags makes each step a plain sum, at the cost of one extra step.
